pages.https://emberwiki.example/wiki/Fort_Joy:
Fort Joy

Fort Joy is the island prison where Emberfall begins: you wake on the beach below the keep, washed ashore after the shipwreck.

Getting out

The only way off the island is by boat from the Saltmarsh Docks.
pages.https://emberwiki.example/wiki/Saltmarsh:
Saltmarsh Docks

The Saltmarsh Docks are the harbour south of Fort Joy.

Harbourmaster

The harbourmaster, Edda Vane, sells the boat ticket to the mainland for 120 gold. She only sells it after nightfall.
